'''Chief Librarian''' was a title used in both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|old]] and [[new Jedi Order]]s designated for the [[Lore Keeper]] who presided over the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Overview==
The Chief Librarian was a position created by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to denote the primary presiding Lore Keeper of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] after the fall of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus's]] [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In addition to guiding the growth and the research in the Archives, the Chief Librarian was the designated leader of the [[Educational Corps]], part of the [[Jedi Service Corps/Legends|Jedi Service Corps]]. Provided with personal chambers adjacent to the Archives, the Chief Librarian worked closely with the [[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]], the leader of the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]]. On occasion, such as in the time following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] with Master [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], the Chief Librarian also held the title of Caretaker.

==History==
Quist's predecessor, [[Barra-Rona-Ban]] was the first Chief Librarian following the Reformation and one of the only Jedi to meet [[Darth Zannah/Legends|one]] of the [[Darth Bane/Legends|two]] remaining [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and survive.<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Even before Master Ban, the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] historian [[Gnost-Dural]] oversaw the recollection of data within the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple Archives]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] following the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The final Chief Librarian, former [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] died among her beloved books when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] on behalf of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Following the reformation of the Order under [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Tionne Solusar]] took up the mantle of Chief Librarian and restored the stacks and added information missing from the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> Master Solusar eventually stepped down from this role and the title was given to Master [[Markre Medjev]].<ref name="FOTJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>
